title: Hall of Legends’ Caps’ Best Ever Tristana Plays
summary: Hall of Legends’ Caps’ Best Ever Tristana Plays  Insider Gaming
content:
Rasmus ‘Caps’ Winther has had a spectacular League of Legends esports career and has made countless mind-blowing plays.

The Dane’s spectacular achievements resulted inCaps being the third inductee into Riot’s LoL Hall of Legends.

As part of that induction, Caps has been given his own in-gameHall of Legends skins: Risen Legend Orianna, Risen Legend Tristana, and Immortalized Legend Tristana.

Many were surprised at the midlaner’s choice of Tristana, but some of his best career plays have come on the champion.

Caps has always been compared with LoL’s all-time great, Lee ‘Faker’ Sang-hyeok. He was even nicknamed ‘Baby Faker’ during his first year as a pro.

And the LEC icon has done what very few Western players have managed; he has gotten the better of the Unkillable Demon King.

title: Demacia Cup goes global with International Invitational
summary: Demacia Cup goes global with International Invitational  Esports.gg
content:
XC is a long-time player and enjoyer of anything video games, with some tech on the side. He has spent countless hours on MOBAs, single-player RPGs, and competitive shooters. XC's also a massive esports fan.

Demacia Cup International Invitational is the Tier-2 Worlds we've always wanted.

Demacia Cup, which was previously exclusive to the Chinese teams of the League of Legends Pro League, is going global. The Demacia Cup International Invitational will have something the community has been asking for a long time: an international event with middle-of-the-table teams.

The 2026 Demacia Cup International Invitational is the upgraded version of the annual Demacia Cup. This is the first iteration, which will welcome teams from other regions and will run fromOct. 3 to Oct. 17.

This expanded Demacia Cup will have 12 teams from six of the major LoL Esports regions:

The regional team allocations were determined byplacements at MSI 2026. The regions that placed 1st and 2nd get three slots, 3rd and 4th place get two, while the rest get one.
